description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to 3000, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Base model is represented by a black line with circle markers, starting at around 60% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 67% at 3000. The FT model is depicted by a blue line with triangle markers, beginning at around 61% ACC and rising to about 69% at 3000. The IKE model is shown as a red line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 64% ACC and increasing to around 71% at 3000. The MEND model is represented by a brown line with diamond markers, beginning at around 65% ACC and rising to about 75% at 3000. The MEMIT model is illustrated by a purple line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 65% ACC and increasing to around 73% at 3000. The ROME model is depicted by a green line with square markers, beginning at around 70% ACC and rising to approximately 78% at 300, before leveling off at around 78% at 3000. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
